subject: general
question: Which state topped "Khelo India Youth Games" in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Maharashtra topped the "Khelo India Youth Games" in 2020 with a total of **256 medals**.
 
• The state won **78 gold, 77 silver, and 101 bronze** medals.
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** is a national-level multidisciplinary grassroots games held in India.
 
• The event aims to promote sports and fitness among youth, identifying and nurturing young talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the Government of India to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It aims to build a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establish India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The first edition of KIYG was held in 2018 in New Delhi.
 
• The KIYG includes sports such as archery, athletics, badminton, basketball, boxing, cycling, football, gymnastics, hockey, judo, kabaddi, kho-kho, shooting, swimming, table tennis, tennis, volleyball, weightlifting, and wrestling.
 
 
 
• **Medal Tally Importance**
 
 
• The medal tally is a table that displays the number of medals won by participants from various states or countries.
 
• It is crucial for evaluating the performance of states and helps in identifying areas requiring more focus and improvement.
 
• The tally includes gold, silver, and bronze medals, contributing to the overall ranking of the participating teams.
 
• A high medal tally indicates a strong sports infrastructure and effective training programs in the respective state.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure**
 
 
• Sports infrastructure includes facilities like stadiums, sports complexes, and training centers.
 
• Quality infrastructure is essential for nurturing talent and providing athletes with the best possible training and competition environment.
 
• Investment in sports infrastructure is crucial for the development and promotion of sports at both grassroots and elite levels.
 
• States with better infrastructure tend to perform better in national and international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Talent Identification and Nurturing**
 
 
• Identifying young talent early is crucial for their development into elite athletes.
 
• Programs like Khelo India are designed to scout and nurture young talents across various sports disciplines.
 
• Providing these young athletes with proper coaching, nutrition, and exposure to competitions is essential for their growth.
 
• Successful talent nurturing contributes to the overall sports culture and excellence of a nation.
